name: Zucchini, Red Pepper & Sun-Dried Tomato Frittata with Dressed Arugula

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim and medium dice zucchini. Place in large bowl.
Preheat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add zucchini and spices; cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 5-6 minutes. (Reserve bowl for the next step.)
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp oregano, dried
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, place eggs, pesto, salt, and pepper in the reserved bowl; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
18 eggs
1 cup sun-dried tomato pesto
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven.

When the zucchini is done, reduce heat to medium-low; pour the egg mixture into the skillet. As eggs set around the edge of the skillet, gently lift cooked portions with a spatula to allow uncooked egg to flow underneath. Cook until bottom and sides are firm but top is still runny, 5-6 minutes.
While the egg is cooking, drain and roughly chop roasted peppers.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (340 g) jars roasted red bell peppers

instructions.primary_message: Sprinkle peppers and cheese over the frittata. Place skillet in the oven and broil until top is set and cheese is melted, 4-5 minutes. Remove from oven.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ cups shredded cheese, Italian blend

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry arugula (skip this step if it came pre-washed).
To serve, cut frittata into wedges and divide between plates. Add arugula to the plate and drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
